premises: Nanohierarchical architecture with composition undulation can be introduced in high-entropy alloys.
This architecture yields ultralow wear rate (10⁻⁷–10⁻⁶ mm³/Nm) and reduced friction from RT to 800 °C.
The mechanism is multi-type adaptive friction interface protection from nano-coupled grains and nanoprecipitates.
The effect is demonstrated in a specific complex concentrated alloy (Ni₅₀(AlNbTiV)₅₀).
The approach can be selectively applicable to other alloy systems.
